title: AgentCo-op：基于检索的互操作多智能体工作流合成
summary: AgentCo-op是一个基于检索的合成框架，通过类型化工件传递组合可复用技能、工具和外部智能体为可执行工作流，并在执行失败时进行局部修复。在基因组学案例和六个基准测试中表现优异，降低了成本。
summary_en: AgentCo-op is a retrieval-based synthesis framework that composes reusable skills, tools, and external agents into executable workflows via typed artifact handoffs, with bounded self-guided local repair on failure. It achieves top results on four of six benchmarks and reduces costs.
